prompt:
Role and task instructions:
You are a helpful, respectful and honest assistant.

User request:
[Goal] You want to rent rock climbing equipment.
[Initial plan] Define Your Needs > Inspect the Equipment > Provide Necessary Information > Pick Up and Return.
[Problem] You find the plan quite vague and miss necessary steps.

Make the plan more comprehensive and concrete. For each step you plan to take, mark with '[Step xx]'.
answer:
[Step 01] Define your climbing plans. Specify whether you will climb indoors or outdoors, the climbing style—bouldering, top-rope, lead, or another type—and your location, dates, group size, and experience level.

[Step 02] Check the venue’s requirements. Ask what equipment is provided, whether outside rental gear is allowed, and whether you need an orientation, belay test, permit, or advance booking. Arrange instruction or a qualified guide if needed.

[Step 03] Create an equipment checklist. For bouldering, consider climbing shoes and outdoor crash pads. For roped climbing, confirm requirements for harnesses, helmets, ropes, belay devices, and other protection with the venue or guide. Record each participant’s sizes.

[Step 04] Find suitable rental providers. Contact the climbing venue, local outdoor shops, or guide services. Confirm that they rent the required items, have suitable sizes, and maintain inspection and retirement records for safety equipment.

[Step 05] Confirm the total cost and rental terms. Request an itemized quote covering rental duration, deposits, taxes, and any cleaning or damage charges. Check cancellation rules, weather-related changes, late fees, and replacement liability.

[Step 06] Reserve the equipment. Book the correct items, quantities, and sizes for your dates. Confirm pickup and return times, opening hours, and whether a fitting appointment is needed. Obtain written confirmation.

[Step 07] Prepare the required information. Bring your reservation details, identification, accepted payment method, and deposit. Complete any waivers and check guardian-consent requirements for minors.

[Step 08] Inspect the equipment with staff. Ask staff to check ropes, harness stitching, attachment points, helmets, and hardware. Report visible wear, damage, missing parts, or uncertain history, and request replacements before accepting the gear.

[Step 09] Check fit, compatibility, and operation. Try on shoes, harnesses, and helmets. Have staff confirm that components work together and demonstrate adjustments and checks. Obtain hands-on instruction for unfamiliar equipment before climbing.

[Step 10] Complete pickup. Compare the equipment against your reservation, record its condition with staff, and keep the receipt and inventory. Confirm care instructions, an emergency contact, and the exact return deadline.

[Step 11] Use and store the equipment correctly. Follow manufacturer and venue instructions, perform partner checks, and protect gear from chemicals, excessive heat, and sharp edges. Stop using questionable equipment and report damage or significant incidents to the provider.

[Step 12] Return and close the rental. Count all items, follow the provider’s cleaning and drying instructions, and return everything on time. Disclose damage or incidents, attend the return inspection, settle any charges, and obtain confirmation of return and deposit release.
